inputs.text: [serious] It was a herbivore. It ate grass and small plants hidden under the snow. [warmly] A thick coat of fur and a big layer of fat kept it warm, and it lived in herds, [gently] just like elephants today.
[nervous] Who could attack it, with all that fur?
[confident] Only prehistoric humans. [warmly] Nobody else dared go after an animal that big.
